page.title: Exposure
page.purpose: Choose a known route, review readiness and publicness, then safely provision or manage its exposure.

priorities.statement: Use the manifest-backed route catalog instead of an unvalidated scenario-name field.
Make duration, target, hostname, tier, authentication, and /public/* scope visible before mutation.
Keep route-level evidence and safe lifecycle actions in one detail surface.

states.description: Route inventory, leases, classifications, and policy evidence are loading.
Search, filters, route collection, and the expose action are available.
No active exposures exist and the first exposure action explains the safety model.
The route collection remains usable while a supporting readiness source is unavailable.
The last route inventory remains visible while refresh is pending.
The selected exposure is being provisioned with progress visible.
The resulting URL, expiry, publicness boundary, and verification state are visible.
The selected route cannot be exposed until its typed readiness blocker is resolved.
Provisioning failed with a classified reason and retry or remediation path.

regions.purpose: Render the route inventory and lease workflow through loading, ready, partial, and failed states.

claims.statement: The Exposure page exposes a stable named main region.
Anonymous access, when enabled, is limited to /public/* and does not make the primary application anonymous.
